lines.vo: Why does one unfinished task keep looping in your head?
That's not you being scatterbrained. That's an open loop.
Tasha has ten things half done, so she grabs her Life Reset Planner.
Psychologists noticed people tend to remember interrupted tasks better than finished ones.
In a twenty eleven study, those nagging goals kept popping up while people tried to focus on something else.
lines.cap: In a 2011 study, those nagging goals kept popping up while people tried to focus on something else.

lines.vo: But when people wrote a specific plan for that goal, the distraction largely faded.
You don't have to finish it tonight. You just have to plan it.
Write the when and the how, then let it go. That's how you stay on track.
